purpose: Bounded source-bundle and build-metadata observations. Proprietary source remains private; generated source availability is not compiled-library, API-completeness, schema-support or runtime qualification.

documented_context.boundary: The pinned manual describes optional schema-wrapper generation and integration. Its illustrative Library/YourSchema names are not literal names of the observed products, and its broader behavior claims are not verified here.

generation.environment: Matched release executable in an isolated offline Wine prefix and virtual display
generation.input_integrity: Original and staged design, schemas and input remained byte-identical; the declared mapping output was not created.
generation.messages: All four selected profiles reported successful mapping validation and code generation with zero errors and warnings. These messages do not report generated-program execution.
generation.scope: Fresh source directories for C#, Java, C++/MSXML 6 and C++/Xerces 3.x. No application-wide default is inferred from the selected options.

profiles.namespace_boundary: The wrapper files contain multiple namespaces, including Products.xs and ProductValuePairs.xs2. A file's first namespace is not the owner of every declaration; nested and supporting public types are not treated as a complete intended API.

external_dependencies.boundary: The property sheet supplies external include/library directories. Header linker directives, not only project AdditionalDependencies, select the libraries.

csharp.boundary: Library output declarations do not establish that Altova.dll, AltovaXML.dll or schema DLLs were built or obtained.

cpp.boundary: These are project declarations, not compiler, Windows SDK, MFC, linker, architecture or ABI qualification.

java.boundary: The default Ant target executes the generated mapping, so it was not run for source inspection. No JAR/classes were obtained; the generic runtime container declares no exact Java version.

source_discrepancies: The observed C++ schema solutions use .slnx rather than the manual illustration's .sln.
The generated C# conversion/data-access exception declarations are in Altova.Types; the manual's Altova namespace wording is retained separately, not treated as an alias.
remaining: Requested compiled C# support and schema DLLs have not been obtained.
Complete public API signatures, inheritance/nesting, ownership, lifetime, null/error behavior and schema-support boundaries remain unqualified.
External MSXML/Xerces, compiler, SDK and MFC dependencies and exact backend applicability remain unqualified.
Independent complete-product inventory review, generated-library execution and native Windows ABI qualification remain open.
